One rare crash.One artefact.

A concurrency bug that happens once in a thousand runs on target becomes something you can freeze, explain and replay at will — on a PC.

01 — Déclic · on targetFreeze

When the process dies, Déclic stops tracelogger and archives trace, pidin, slog2 and core into one RDA1 file.

02 — Autopsie · on hostExplain

The C11 core rebuilds the wait-for graph and the blocking chain, and names the culprit with a frozen rule — on one page.

03 — Réplique · on hostReplay

A scheduler model replays the trace deterministically, hash for hash, and answers “what if this thread had priority 20?”.
